text:
Ravi: starting an onboarding smoke for orion48k (int8 dynamic q) with extended prefill. target window 48k, prefill ramp to 42k. seeing a 'backshuffle' where older tokens reappear 20-40 tokens after boundary. dumping notes.
Linh: repro command I ran:
```
./run_onboard --model orion48k --quant int8 --context 49152 --prefill 42000 --kvcache-prefetch 1 --rope-mode progressive
```
Taylor: symptoms: output looks fine until ~41,700 tokens then occasionally the decoder emits a block that matches tokens from ~41,200..41,240. it's not deterministic but high-variance.
Priya: quick sanitized log snippet:
```
[onboard] prefill=41712
[kv] read shard=5 idx=12087 offset=18446744073709551608
[decode] emitted seq: ... 331 442 553 331 442 553 ...
```
Ravi: note the huge offset (-8 when interpreted as signed) -> smells like unsigned wrap.
Linh: I also see a mismatch between the rope phase applied at prefill and the one used inside the prefetcher: progressive mode scales phase per-tile differently.
Taylor: perf note: enabling kvcache-prefetch reduces latency but increases these incidents. with prefetch=0 the issue is rare.
Priya: ran bisect across kernel versions: good on kernel v1.14, introduced in v1.15 where we added tiled prefetch and an 'optimistic index' fastpath.
Ravi: hypothesis: optimistic fastpath returns a stale tile index when concurrent flush/evict races with prefill completion; with progressive rope scaling the stale tile's pos-emb phase is off and results in coherent repeats.
Linh: mitigation tested: add atomic fence around tile-index publish -> reduces frequency by ~95% but perf hit ~+8%.
Taylor: quick workaround: --kvcache-prefetch=0 or --rope-mode=uniform avoids repeats. neither is ideal for production.
Priya: CI: pushed a tiny test to ci/longprefill to assert no repeated 4-token windows for prefill=40k..44k. running now.
ci-bot: longprefill (ci/longprefill)  PASS  checks=short-repeat-assert
Ravi: good sign. action items:
- Linh: add signed/unsigned defensive checks in shard index codepath and instrument offsets (low overhead counter).
- Taylor: add a microbenchmark measuring prefetch atomic cost and verify tail-latency impact.
- Priya: extend goldset with 3 long prompts that historically triggered repeats and run nightly.
- Ravi: coordinate release notes entry and flag for Dedicated customers with orion48k rolling upgrade.
Linh: will open PR for index-fix + small opt-in featureflag to re-enable prefetch safely.
Taylor: will run parameter sweep on prefetch backoff heuristics (0/1/2) and report.
Priya: adding a short doc in the onboarding playbook about "detecting backshuffle" with grep pattern and tokenizer alignment check.
Ravi: thanks all. keep short updates here; if you need more context DM. :lock:
